data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'amir' which means 'prince' or 'commander'. The name Amirul carries the meaning “Prince, Commander” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amirul usually hope their child will grow to embody prince, commander and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: أمرुल
in_arabic.long_meaning: أمرول هو اسم عربي يعني الأمير أو الزعيم أو القائد، ومشتق من الكلمة العربية أَمَرَ التي تُستخدم في القرآن الكريم لوصف القيادة والزعامة، ويحمل هذا الاسم معنىً sâuخاً في الثقافة الإسلامية حيث ي象ز القيادة الصالحة والزعامة الحكيمة

in_urdu.name: امیرال
in_urdu.long_meaning: امیرال ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب امیر یا سردار یا لیڈر ہے، جو کہ قرآن پاک میں ذکر کردہ لفظ أَمَرَ سے ماخوذ ہے، اور یہ نام مسلم ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت کا حامل ہے جو نیک اور حکیم لیڈرشپ کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अमीरुल
in_hindi.long_meaning: अमीरुल एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ अमीर या सरदार या नेता है, जो कि कुरान में वर्णित शब्द أَمَرَ से लिया गया है, और यह नाम मुस्लिम संस्कृति में बहुत महत्व रखता है जो अच्छी और बुद्धिमान नेतृत्व का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है

in_pashto.name: امیرال

It evokes images of brave warriors, wise leaders, and powerful monarchs. The title 'Amirul' was often bestowed upon great Islamic scholars, military leaders, and spiritual guides, reflecting their notable stature and revered status in their communities. The name continues to be a source of pride and inspiration for Muslims, symbolizing leadership, strength, and honor.

Just as a prince or commander leads and guides his people, we too are called upon to guide our own souls towards the path of righteousness. The name inspires us to strive for excellence in our religious practice and to be role models for others in our community. Ultimately, the name Amirul serves as a reminder of the moral and spiritual responsibilities that come with the great gift of life, and motivates us to live up to our highest potential.
